reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the well-established γ/γ′ interface creep-blocking mechanism from Ni-based superalloys and high-entropy superalloys (HESAs) to a multilayer HEA coating architecture, but the core idea of using coherent interfaces to impede dislocations and diffusion is explicitly stated in the provided passages (P2, P5, P10, P11). The proposal does not combine findings from different papers, introduce a new mechanism, or resolve a conflict; it merely applies a known mechanism to a different geometry (multilayers instead of precipitates) without a stated reason why it should work there, making it a minor variation of existing knowledge.
